method: Original stdout independently parsed with Decimal. For each phase/endpoint use the median of three within-process trials, then the mean of the two paired master-minus-final block differences. The 65-frame sequence is formed per trial before taking its process median. Retain both blocks and their range; no confidence intervals, significance claims, exclusions, or percentages.
scope: Application timing exploration only. No new pixel preflight is claimed for these fonts. Timings compare complete current patch against frozen master; they do not isolate outline retention or hinting.
